description: Just like finding a soulmate, finding the right city can change your life! Answer 12 questions to discover which city matches your personality type.

ISTJ.title: Your Soulmate City: Tokyo, Japan
ISTJ.description: Like a reliable partner, Tokyo offers structure, efficiency, and order. Its famous transit system runs like clockwork, and the city rewards those who appreciate discipline and precision. You'll love the cleanliness, safety, and respect for traditions blended with cutting-edge innovation.

ISFJ.title: Your Soulmate City: Kyoto, Japan
ISFJ.description: Gentle and nurturing, Kyoto wraps around you like a warm embrace. The city values community, tradition, and taking care of others. Its peaceful temples, beautiful gardens, and respectful culture make it perfect for those who find joy in serving and protecting what matters most.

INFJ.title: Your Soulmate City: Vienna, Austria
INFJ.description: Soul meets soul in Vienna's poetic streets. This city breathes art, music, and deep philosophy. You'll find like-minded dreamers in cozy cafés, inspire change in its intellectual circles, and lose yourself in the elegant architecture that mirrors your inner world.

INTJ.title: Your Soulmate City: Berlin, Germany
INTJ.description: For the strategic mind, Berlin is a playground of ideas and innovation. The city embraces independence, rewards competence, and offers endless opportunities for those who think ahead. Its efficient systems and intellectual freedom make it the perfect match for the mastermind.

ISTP.title: Your Soulmate City: Munich, Germany
ISTP.description: Practical and adventurous, Munich offers the perfect balance of precision and freedom. Whether you're exploring the Alps, working on practical projects, or enjoying the city's engineering marvels, Munich rewards hands-on problem-solvers with its blend of tradition and innovation.

ISFP.title: Your Soulmate City: Florence, Italy
ISFP.description: In Florence, beauty lives and breathes. This city is a canvas of art, nature, and aesthetic wonder that speaks directly to your sensitive soul. Wander through Renaissance streets, savor local flavors, and let your creative spirit flourish in this romantic Italian gem.

INFP.title: Your Soulmate City: Prague, Czech Republic
INFP.description: Prague feels like it was dreamed up just for you - a fairytale city of cobblestone streets, mysterious bridges, and endless inspiration. Its artistic soul and magical atmosphere perfectly match your idealist heart. Here, dreams don't just exist - they flourish.

INTP.title: Your Soulmate City: Amsterdam, Netherlands
INTP.description: Amsterdam's progressive thinking and intellectual freedom call to your curious mind. The city's innovative spirit, beautiful canal systems, and 'figure it out' attitude create the perfect environment for exploring ideas, building theories, and solving complex puzzles.

ESTP.title: Your Soulmate City: New York City, USA
ESTP.description: New York City never sleeps, and neither will you in this energy-packed metropolis. If you love action, excitement, and making things happen, NYC is your playground. The city rewards risk-takers, offers endless adventures, and connects you with ambitious people from every corner of the world.

ESFP.title: Your Soulmate City: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
ESFP.description: Rio is a celebration waiting to happen! If you bring the energy, this city will multiply it tenfold. Dance in the streets, soak up the sun on famous beaches, and let your spontaneous spirit run free. Life is a party here, and you're invited to lead the dance.

ENFP.title: Your Soulmate City: Barcelona, Spain
ENFP.description: Barcelona ignites your imagination like few other places can. Its artistic spirit, vibrant culture, and infectious energy make it the perfect playground for your enthusiastic soul. Every street offers inspiration, every conversation sparks new ideas, and life feels like one grand adventure.

ENTP.title: Your Soulmate City: Singapore
ENTP.description: Singapore is a brainstormer's paradise - innovative, diverse, and always pushing boundaries. This city-state thrives on debate, welcomes disruptors, and offers endless opportunities for those who love to challenge the status quo. Your ideas won't just be heard - they'll be celebrated.

ESTJ.title: Your Soulmate City: Shanghai, China
ESTJ.description: Shanghai is for the bold and ambitious. If you love structure, success, and making things happen, this dynamic city speaks your language. Its fast-paced energy, business opportunities, and modern architecture attract driven individuals who want to build empires.

ESFJ.title: Your Soulmate City: Sydney, Australia
ESFJ.description: Sydney wraps you in warmth - both from its sunny climate and friendly people. This city values community, hospitality, and creating harmony. You'll thrive in its balanced lifestyle, where work and play coexist beautifully, and everyone feels like part of the family.

ENFJ.title: Your Soulmate City: London, UK
ENFJ.description: London embraces your natural leadership and charisma. This cosmopolitan city offers endless opportunities to inspire, connect, and make a difference. Its diverse communities, cultural richness, and global influence make it the perfect stage for your vision to shine.

ENTJ.title: Your Soulmate City: Dubai, UAE
ENTJ.description: Dubai was built for those who dream big and execute bigger. If you're driven, ambitious, and love turning impossible visions into reality, this city is your kingdom. Its architectural marvels, business opportunities, and 'anything is possible' attitude match your commanding spirit.
